name: Devilled Oysters
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Clean, drain, and slightly chop oysters.
Make a sauce of butter, flour, and milk; add egg yolk, seasonings, and oysters.
Arrange buttered scallop shells in a dripping-pan, half fill with mixture, cover with buttered crumbs, and bake twelve to fifteen minutes in a hot oven.
Deep oyster shells may be used in place of scallop shells.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
